entries.198688da8eb6a0f4: This is the company's core business. The company plans and sells package tours in more than 170 countries worldwide, built around the intellectual themes of nature, culture, art and humanity. The company operates tours designed to make sightseeing time fulfilling without stopping at duty-free shops for commissions. The number of travelers by destination for escorted group tours organized in the fiscal year ended September 2025 totaled 6,712.
entries.2e2e5b8e7e390b2e: A business conducted by the consolidated subsidiary Eurasia Service Co., Ltd. It dispatches tour escorts and office staff for tours organized by the company. entries.41925724bc470da0: This is the single segment of the group. The company plans and sells original self-produced tours focused on sightseeing content with the themes of nature, culture, art and humanity, covering the whole world. Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥4,787 million; within sales of merchandise, travel agency business accounted for ¥4,773 million and other sales (income from insurance premium commissions) for ¥13 million. Travel fees are received as advance payments, and the company continues to operate without borrowings.
